redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.description: 301s for renamed products, categories and collections are created automatically. Chains are collapsed.

empty.title: No redirects yet
empty.description: They appear when page URLs change or after a CSV import.

form.fromHint: Storefront path: /products/old. Domain, query and trailing slash are dropped.
form.toHint: If the target redirects itself, the rule points straight to the final page.

import.hint: Columns: from;to;code. Empty “to” means 410. The file is imported entirely or not at all.

delete.title: Delete the record?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Its storefront URLs will stop opening (410).

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Manufacturers: own /brands/… page and catalog filter.

empty.title: No brands yet
empty.description: Add a brand manually — later they will come with supplier imports.

hints.handle: Empty — built from the name. Changing it adds a 301 from the old URL; renaming keeps the URL.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Store blog: /blog/… pages. Drafts are hidden from the storefront.

empty.title: No articles yet
empty.description: Articles bring search traffic to categories and products.

hints.handle: Empty — built from the name. Changing it adds a 301 from the old URL; renaming keeps the URL.
hints.body: HTML. An editor will come with content pages.

filterPages.title: Landing pages
filterPages.description: “Category + filters” with own /catalog/{category}/… URL and meta — only these are indexed.

empty.title: No landing pages yet
empty.description: E.g. “Nike sneakers”: the Sneakers category filtered by brand.

hints.handle: Empty — built from the name. Unique within the category; renaming the category adds 301s for all its landing pages.
hints.filters: JSON: filter code → values, e.g. { "brand": ["nike"] }. Codes — from Attributes, values — their slugs.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Dropshipping: catalog, purchase prices and stock come from suppliers, orders go to them. Each has its own virtual stock location.
suppliers.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" will be deleted with its offers — its stock will drop to zero.

empty.title: No suppliers yet
empty.description: Add a supplier — it gets a stock location, and its offers become product stock.

hints.is_active: An inactive supplier doesn't sell: its offers' stock drops to zero.
hints.ship_city: Supplier's stock location address — carriers calculate shipping from it.
hints.assembly_days: How long the supplier assembles an order — part of the delivery time on the product page.
hints.exchange: JSON: CommerceML exchange settings (push/pull, URL, price type) — used by the import.
hints.markup: JSON: supplier markup rules — used for retail prices.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Specs table on the product page and catalog filters. The code is used in filter URLs and filter pages.
attributes.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" will be deleted with its values on all products.

hints.handle: Empty — from the name. The code goes into filter URLs — change with care.
hints.type: Number — for range filters; yes/no — a toggle.
hints.rank: Lower goes first in the specs table and filters.

productCatalog.title: Catalog
productCatalog.mainCategoryHint: Breadcrumbs and canonical come from it. Required to publish.

supplierOffers.title: Suppliers
supplierOffers.description: On sale: {{count}} pcs — total stock of active suppliers.
supplierOffers.empty: No offers — the product can't be published without them.

form.fixedHint: Supplier and variant can't be changed later — delete the offer and create a new one.
form.externalIdHint: Product ID in the supplier's feed (product#characteristic) — the import updates the offer by it.
form.quantityHint: Stock goes to the supplier's location; usually updated by the import.

delete.title: Delete offer?
delete.description: Stock of "{{supplier}}" for "{{variant}}" will stop selling.

productAttributes.title: Attributes
productAttributes.description: Product values; variant values come with the import.
productAttributes.empty: No attributes yet — add them in the Attributes section.
